package http

import (
	"bytes"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
)

func TestPublicPublicationRoutesDoNotOpenStudentSandboxRoutes(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(RouterDependencies{
		AnswerHandler:              &handlers.AnswerHandler{},
		StudentPracticeTaskHandler: &handlers.StudentPracticeTaskHandler{},
	})

	publicationRequest := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/public/v1/practice-task-publications/not-a-valid-share-slug", nil)
	publicationResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(publicationResponse, publicationRequest)
	if publicationResponse.Code != http.StatusNotFound {
		t.Fatalf("public publication route should be reachable without auth and fail closed by slug, got %d", publicationResponse.Code)
	}

	sandboxRequest := httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodPost,
		"/api/v1/student/student-practice-tasks/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/parts/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002/open",
		nil,
	)
	sandboxResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(sandboxResponse, sandboxRequest)
	if sandboxResponse.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
		t.Fatalf("live sandbox route must remain authenticated, got %d", sandboxResponse.Code)
	}
}

func TestLegacyPracticeWriterIsGoneByDefault(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(RouterDependencies{
		AnswerHandler:              &handlers.AnswerHandler{},
		StudentPracticeTaskHandler: &handlers.StudentPracticeTaskHandler{},
	})
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/v1/student/student-practice-tasks", bytes.NewReader([]byte(`{}`)))
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusGone || !bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte("ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator")) {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
}
